name: Misto Holdings Corp.
summary: Misto Holdings Corp., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the sale of textile products, clothing, footwear, leather products, watches, cosmetics, golf equipment, and other products in South Korea, the United States, and internationally. It is also involved in the retail and wholesale of apparel and footwear under the FILA brand. In addition, the company manufactures and sells golf products, including golf balls, golf clubs, and golf gears under the Titleist brand; and licenses FILA branded products. It operates approximately 529 stores. The company was formerly known as FILA Korea Ltd. and changed its name to Misto Holdings Corp. in January 2020. Misto Holdings Corp. was founded in 1991 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
